name: Marco Rubio
role: U.S. Secretary of State (2025-); U.S. Senator from Florida (2011-2025)
summary: A Cuban-American Republican from Florida who rose as a Tea Party senator, co-wrote the 2013 Gang of Eight immigration bill, then moved toward border-first immigration policy. He holds conservative positions on abortion, marriage, guns, drugs and health care, and has hawkish views on China, Cuba, Iran and Venezuela. By 2019 he favored industrial policy and 'common-good capitalism', and as Secretary of State he has defended tariffs, put foreign aid under State Department control and ranked national interest above the post-war global order.

sources.title: Political positions of Marco Rubio
sources.author: Wikipedia
sources.usedFor: Positions with cited statements and votes: drugs, guns, taxes, health care, surveillance, Israel, NATO, abortion, marriage, environment

universal-healthcare.rationale: Campaigned to repeal Obamacare completely and replace it with tax-free health money, savings accounts and refundable tax credits; later said that promised free health care means government decides your doctor.

raise-minimum-wage.rationale: In 2014 he proposed replacing the earned income tax credit with a wage enhancement as a better way to support low-wage workers than simply raising the minimum wage.

markets-allocate-better.rationale: Praises the efficiency of the American market economy against Chinese command and control, but his 2019 report says decisions have been outsourced too fully to market preference and that growth is built, not unlocked.

tax-the-wealthy.rationale: His 2015 tax plan with Mike Lee set a top rate of 35 percent and eliminated capital gains and estate taxes; he voted against the 2012 fiscal cliff deal over its new taxes.

regulate-corporations.rationale: Pledged to cap regulation on business, yet his 2019 report and speech press corporations over shareholder primacy and offshoring, and he proposed taxing buybacks; the evidence points both ways.

surveillance-ok.rationale: Voted to extend the Patriot Act's roving wiretap provision and favors collecting bulk metadata for national security.

legalize-drugs.rationale: Has said legalizing drugs would be a great mistake and opposed legalizing or decriminalizing marijuana.

restrict-hate-speech.rationale: Criticised Western governments that censor and prosecute domestic political opponents, and closed the State Department office he said engaged in censorship.

limit-guns.rationale: A+ NRA rating, voted against expanded background checks in 2013, opposes an assault weapons ban; also backed raising the rifle age to 21, a bump stock ban and gun violence restraining orders.

empower-police-military.rationale: Prioritises defense spending, fought sequestration cuts to the military, and campaigned to rebuild the US military.

decide-locally.rationale: Says states should define marriage and opposed Common Core as federal imposition, but supports federal limits on abortion; mixed.

rehabilitation.rationale: In 2018 he was among 12 senators voting against the First Step Act criminal justice reform; said reductions in drug sentences need great care.

traditional-family.rationale: Called traditional marriage between one man and one woman an important cornerstone of society and in 2019 called providing for one's family core to being a man.

same-sex-marriage.rationale: Says marriage is between one man and one woman, disagreed with Obergefell, and called a 2022 vote to codify marriage equality a waste of time.

abortion-legal.rationale: Opposes legal abortion even in cases of rape and incest, said life begins at conception, and praised Dobbs.

preserve-national-culture.rationale: Argued the post-Cold War idea of abandoning national sovereignty and identity was a dangerous delusion, and urged the West to take pride in its heritage.

reduce-immigration.rationale: Told the Senate that unrestrained movement of people caused a historic migration crisis and in 2026 warned about mass migration; he has also backed modernising legal immigration.

empower-international-orgs.rationale: Told the Senate the post-war global order is obsolete and a weapon used against America, criticised UN veto abuse and sanctioned ICC judges.

free-trade.rationale: Told the Senate that an almost religious commitment to free and unfettered trade shrank the middle class and collapsed industry, and called it a dangerous delusion.

nation-first.rationale: Says the State Department's top priority is the United States and that national interest comes before the global order and before what is good for another country.

humanitarian-intervention.rationale: Backed US participation in the 2011 Libya campaign and no-fly zones in Syria to protect civilians.

open-borders.rationale: Blames open borders for mass migration and fentanyl, and insisted on securing the border before any other immigration step.

limit-growth.rationale: Said it is in the common good to protect both the environment and the economy and ridiculed efforts to make energy expensive.

drastic-climate-action.rationale: Said no credible scenario justifies the Green New Deal's claims, argues other nations like China are mainly responsible, and calls past green energy policy hyperbole.

central-planning.rationale: Told the Senate that command and control central planning is a flawed economic approach, and contrasted China's command regime with America's market economy.

tax-inheritance.rationale: The Rubio-Lee tax plan of 2015 would have eliminated taxes on inherited estates.

basic-income.rationale: In his 2019 Catholic University speech he said a government that guarantees a basic income also decides where you work and how much you make.

tariffs-protect-industry.rationale: As Secretary of State he defended Trump's tariffs: critical industries such as steel, aluminum and semiconductors need domestic capacity protected by incentives to produce in the United States.

state-directs-investment.rationale: His 2019 committee report and hearing statement call for a US industrial strategy centred on domestic physical investment and SBA programs for innovation-focused production, and he has supported federal R&D and industrial policy.

military-superiority.rationale: Campaigned to rebuild the US military, fought sequestration, and says American strength deters adversaries.

unbreakable-encryption.rationale: Praised encryption and opposed forcing Apple to build a backdoor after the San Bernardino attack.

profit-exploitation.rationale: In his 2019 speech he said businesses have a right to make profits; he criticised deserting workers, not profit as exploitation.

territorial-expansion.rationale: In January 2025 said acquiring Greenland was in the national interest without ruling out coercion, and pursued Western Hemisphere influence and a Greenland deal.

jewish-state-israel.rationale: Commended recognition of Jerusalem as the eternal capital of the Jewish state of Israel and calls Israel a close ally.

avoid-deficit-stimulus.rationale: Opposed the 2009 stimulus and backs a balanced budget amendment; his 2019 report notes government borrowing as investor of last resort without endorsing it.

force-without-un.rationale: Defended direct US strikes on Iranian nuclear sites in 2025 and was reported as the driving force behind the 2026 operation capturing Maduro; neither had UN Security Council approval.

class-collaboration.rationale: His 2019 report describes value creation as inherently collaborative and dependent on employee contribution, and criticises treating workers as inputs.

expand-fossil-fuels.rationale: Called to end the crude oil export ban, expand coal, gas and fracking, and urges allies to develop domestic oil and gas.

national-mission.rationale: Rejected the post-Cold War idea that foreign policy should serve a liberal world order and said policy should rest on core national interest.

equal-moral-worth.rationale: Told the committee the nation was founded on the truth that all men are created equal and that rights come from God.

trade-surplus.rationale: Criticises trade deficits as an off-kilter balance and asks why the EU has a surplus with the US; he does not state a general aim of exporting more than importing.

party-controls-media.rationale: Criticised governments that censor opponents and shut down a State office he said engaged in censorship.

long-naturalization-wait.rationale: His 2015 sequence put any green card or citizenship debate 10 to 12 years after border security; the 2013 bill he co-wrote included a long probationary path.

pool-sovereignty.rationale: Called abandoning national sovereignty for 'one human family' a dangerous delusion.

end-foreign-alliances.rationale: Argued that walking away from Asia-Pacific defense commitments would make Japan and South Korea nuclear powers, and told the Senate that alliances prevented world war.

death-penalty.rationale: Favors streamlining appeals so the death penalty is carried out more often.

creationism-in-schools.rationale: As a 2016 candidate he argued for teaching both creationism and evolution.

religious-exemptions.rationale: In the 2016 debates he pointed to the Little Sisters of the Poor suit and said groups with traditional values face discrimination.

rich-countries-aid-poor.rationale: Says every aid dollar must make America safer, stronger or more prosperous, and ended USAID as an independent agency.

no-land-for-peace.rationale: Has opposed a two-state solution since 2015 and denounced the UN resolution condemning settlements as one-sided.

collective-defense.rationale: Called NATO more important than ever, co-sponsored the law barring a president from leaving NATO without Congress, and said he would risk war with Russia to defend Turkey.

flat-income-tax.rationale: His 2015 plan had graduated brackets of 15 and 35 percent, later 15, 25 and 35, rather than a single flat rate.

space-expansion.rationale: Supports space exploration funding as part of innovation policy but has not called it a central goal.

no-bailouts.rationale: Led the effort to eliminate the Obamacare risk-corridor fund, which he called a taxpayer bailout of insurers.

arm-foreign-insurgents.rationale: Supported arming Syrian rebels during the Syrian war.

non-intervention.rationale: Supported the 2011 Libya intervention, no-fly zones in Syria, Taiwan's defense, and led 2026 Venezuela policy.

national-law-over-international.rationale: Argued the ICC's claim over non-members is dangerous to the US and a test run for prosecuting Americans.

defeat-communism.rationale: Defender of the Cuba embargo, opposed the Obama thaw, and sanctioned Cuba's GAESA as the heart of its communist system.

capitalism-progressive.rationale: His 2019 report says American capitalism produced great prosperity in prior generations and argues for returning to its capital-building traditions.

neither-capitalism-nor-communism.rationale: Calls for 'common-good capitalism' between corporatism and socialism, but still within capitalism and rejects socialism.

abolish-armed-forces.rationale: Calls for rebuilding the US military.

stay-neutral-between-blocs.rationale: Committed to US alliances in Europe and the Indo-Pacific and treats China as a rival bloc leader to be confronted.

defensive-wars-only.rationale: Supported military action in Libya, and as Secretary of State was a driving force of the 2026 Venezuela operation and a preventive attack on Iran.

free-public-college.rationale: Said in the same speech that a government promising free college also decides what school you attend and what you are taught.

future-generations.rationale: Said Pope Francis reminded us to be good caretakers of the planet and that protecting the environment is in the common good.

in-work-tax-credits.rationale: Proposed a federal wage enhancement for low-wage workers in place of the EITC and a $2,500 per-child tax credit.

fiscal-rules-binding.rationale: Supports a balanced budget amendment and statutory caps on federal spending.

pollution-tort-liability.rationale: Cosponsored a 2019 bill to list PFAS as hazardous and require polluters to clean up or pay; one bill only.

international-criminal-courts.rationale: Said the ICC damaged its credibility, sanctioned its judges in 2025 and announced a campaign to dismantle it.

close-ties-china.rationale: Called China's challenge to American competitiveness unprecedented, sponsored the Uyghur Forced Labor Prevention Act, and ordered aggressive revocation of Chinese student visas.

patriotism-serves-workers.rationale: Frames confronting China and rebuilding manufacturing as tied to dignified work for ordinary families, saying the country cannot leave anyone behind.

notes: Immigration: co-wrote the 2013 Senate bill with a path to legal status, then said border security must come first; recent position weighted. Trade: supported TPP in 2015-16 and opposed tariffs earlier; by 2019 and as Secretary of State he backs tariffs and industrial policy, and calls free trade a dangerous delusion. Several 2026 items (Venezuela, Iran) are taken from Wikipedia's account of his record. Only positions found in opened sources are recorded; the rest are null.
